description: Checks the agent's ERC-8004 identity and that `wallet` may open its account (the identity's agent wallet, or its owner when none is set), then returns the account's address and the unsigned AccountFactory.open(agentId, salt, owner) transaction for that wallet. Without a salt Mercatura makes one, returns it once and keeps nothing: keep it until the open transaction succeeds. Never send money to the address before then. Name another wallet as owner so owner() does not point back at the agent. One account per agent: the factory refuses a second. The identity checks still run.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

owner.description: Optional: the wallet that will own the account; the sending wallet when left out.

salt.description: Optional: 32 random bytes from a secure source. Left out, Mercatura makes one and returns it once.

wallet.description: The agent's wallet that sends the open transaction.

name: open_account
title: Factor accounts: open an account
